results.title: Taste and Tears
results.overview: Bound by shared loneliness, Shinya and his classmate Yuka grow close while working on their school newspaper. But after a sudden incident, Yuka vanishes without a trace, leaving Shinya clinging to an unfulfilled promise. Thirty years later, long-buried truths about Yuka’s past finally surface, forcing Shinya to confront what was lost, and what remained unsaid.

results.title: Lacuna
results.overview: As she struggles to finish her short film, a first-time filmmaker travels through her memory bank in search of inspiration.

results.title: The Minds Of 99 - Tre Døgn i Parken
results.original_title: The Minds Of 99 - Tre Døgn i Parken
results.overview: THE MINDS OF 99 – THREE DAYS IN THE PARK is a concert documentary film that follows the band and the individual members in the period leading up to, during, and after the magical weekend in the Park. Through a compilation of more than 300 hours of material, the audience is taken behind the scenes and gets up close to the band and the pressures and dilemmas, thoughts and emotions they encounter on the journey to the three critically acclaimed stadium concerts.

results.title: Bus stop
results.overview: Wearing her gákti, a Sámi woman faces a gauntlet of ignorance on her way to catch a bus - a satirical, heartfelt take on everyday resistance.

results.title: PURPLE PATROL!
results.overview: A vigilante trio summons an otherworldly being to help protect the queer community.

results.title: Royal
results.overview: After getting arrested, a con man discovers his comatose father's company - built by his late mother - is about to collapse. Now he must use his skills to protect her legacy and save the business.

results.title: Pimple
results.overview: A young boy's pimple bursts, leading to a bloody disaster.

results.title: Ravens
results.overview: Enigmatic, rejected, heartbroken. Masahisa Fukase must rebuild his life, overcome tradition, his inner demons and the pain of a broken marriage. The fascinating love story of the iconic Japanese photographer, his wife, his art and his family told for the very first time. A love consumed and destroyed by a life of photography.

results.title: A Wonderful Lie
results.overview: When a fading romance author goes missing, a team of investigators piece together clues that ultimately lead them to a shocking discovery.

results.title: Krakken - En Vivo desde Núcleo
results.overview: Mexican alternative rock band Krakken performs live at Núcleo Emergente, Mexico City. Recorded April 26, 2025.

results.title: Stella Stevens: The Last Starlet
results.overview: The film explores the personal and professional life of Stella Stevens, one of Hollywood's last starlets. Her career spanned from the final days of the male dominated old Hollywood studio system, through the evolution of the new Hollywood, which coincided with the struggle for women's rights, and human rights of all races and identities, for which she was an advocate.

results.title: Narayaneente Moonnaanmakkal
results.overview: Three distanced, discordant brothers strive to put aside their differences as they reunite after decades at their ancestral home to give their dying mother a peaceful send off, but soon are at loggerheads as the house brings up painful memories of their tumultuous past.

results.title: Наследники Победы
results.overview: Three young army members come to congratulate a veteran of the Great Patriotic War on the holiday. He shares memories of his wartime childhood in Siberia, telling stories about the small and big feats of his friends.

results.title: Pocongdorie
results.overview: While cleaning out their parental home, siblings Dwi and Daya come across their deceased mother, who came back from the dead as a pocong.

results.title: Best of the West Tour with Dan Gonzo Machanik
results.original_title: Best of the West Tour with Dan Gonzo Machanik
results.overview: Stand-up comedy special following Bay Area comedian Dan "Gonzo" Machanik on his Best of the West Tour, directed, produced, and edited by Jayson Johnson.

results.title: Everlasting: Life and Legacy of Medgar Evers
results.original_title: Everlasting: Life and Legacy of Medgar Evers
results.overview: An MPB Original Production honoring the life, work, and impact of one of Mississippi’s most courageous voices. This powerful two-hour documentary features interviews with Evers’ family, colleagues, and historians. Everlasting offers a moving, personal look at his legacy in the fight for civil rights.

results.title: VMX Rewind: The Best Of VMX 2025
results.original_title: VMX Rewind: The Best Of VMX 2025
results.overview: As we wrap up the year, the sultry Zsara Laxamana takes us through a sizzling lookback at 2025’s hottest movies. Stick around to see if your favorites made it!

results.title: Slow Down the Fall
results.overview: The reunion of two ski jumping champions whose romantic past will resurface as they face the demands of their sponsors.

results.title: Stranger
results.overview: When 19-year-old Aathi and her family, as the first farmers ever, arrive in what is now known as Denmark, her family is killed by a local tribe of hunter-gatherers. To survive, Aathi and her brother are forced to live with the tribe.
